label: Galaxy S24 smartphone
description: Samsung Galaxy S24 — 6.2-inch flagship, Wi-Fi 6E and 5G sub-6/mmWave; USB-C 3.2 with DeX and Ethernet over a dock.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz, HE160) — note the S24 and S24+ ship 6E; only the S24 Ultra carries Wi-Fi 7, so do not treat the whole S24 family as 802.11be. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz + mmWave (US). USB-C 3.2 Gen 2, DeX, dock Ethernet present (usb0).
